7-13-16 Special Criminal Justice Commission Meeting
44933 Fern Avenue, Lancaster, CA 93534
Chairman David Vierra, Vice Chairman Jeff Little
Commissioner Mark Brown; Commissioner Sheldon Carter;
Commissioner Howard Harris; Commissioner Jin Hur
Commissioner Liza Rodriguez
LANCASTER CRIMINAL JUSTICE COMMISSION
AGENDA
Wednesday
July 13, 2016
10:30 a.m.
Council Chambers - Lancaster City Hall
Posted by 05:00 p.m. on July 9, 2016
at the entrance to the Lancaster City Hall Council Chambers
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
Commission Members: Brown, Carter, Harris, Hur, Rodriguez; Vice Chairman Little; Chairman Vierra
INVOCATION
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PUBLIC BUSINESS FROM THE FLOOR - AGENDIZED ITEMS
Citizens who would like to address the Criminal Justice Commission on any agendized item may do so when the item is being considered by the Commission. Please complete a speaker card and identify the agenda item you would like to discuss. Individual speakers are limited to three (3) minutes each.
NEW BUSINESS
NB 1. Measure A – The Safe and Compassionate Community Act
Recommendation:
Review, discuss and authorize the Criminal Justice Commission Chair to sign the argument in favor of
Measure A – The Safe and Compassionate Community Act if requested by Measure proponents.
COMMISSIONER COMMENTS
ADJOURNMENT
Next Regular Meeting:
Wednesday, August 10, 2016 – 10:00 a.m.
MEETING ASSISTANCE INFORMATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, this meeting will be held at a location accessible to persons with disabilities; if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, please contact the City Clerk at (661)723-6020. Services such as American Sign Language interpreters, a reader during the meeting, and/or large print copies of the agenda are available. To ensure availability, you are advised to make your request at least 72 hours prior to the meeting/event you wish to attend.Â  Due to difficulties in securing sign language interpreters, five or more business days notice is strongly recommended.Â  For additional information, please contact the City Clerk at (661)723-6020.
All documents available for public review are on file with the City Clerk Department.
AGENDA ADDENDUM INFORMATION
On occasion items may be added after the agenda has been mailed to subscribers. Copies of the agenda addendum item will be available at the City Clerk Department and are posted with the agenda on the windows of the City Council Chambers. For more information, please call the City Clerk Department at (661) 723-6020.
